Later, Trump said he had no regrets about his midterm messaging and strategy, saying there was much “love” at his rallies but it didn’t translate to GOP candidate success.

Republicans have started pointing fingers at who and what is to blame for the wipeout after Democrats decisively flipped control of both the House and the Senate.
